newsAll.head: Breece Hall: Status to be updated Wednesday

newsAll.head: Courtland Sutton: Team-high 46 rec yards in comeback win
newsAll.body: Sutton caught three of seven targets for 46 yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.

newsAll.head: J.K. Dobbins: Doesn't do much with 17 carries
newsAll.body: Dobbins rushed 17 times for 49 yards while catching one of two targets for four yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.

newsAll.head: RJ Harvey: Seven targets, two carries in Week 3
newsAll.body: Harvey (hamstring) rushed twice for six yards while catching six of seven targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams.

newsAll.head: Blake Corum: Limited workload during SNF
